description:
Who You'll Work With

You’ll be working in São Paulo as part of our global Risk and Resilience Practice supporting clients in many different industries facing challenges of developing and implementing tailored concepts for risk recognition, measurement, and control.

Facing extreme volatility in financial and commodity markets, more and more of our clients are realizing that effective, risk-informed strategy can offer a major source of competitive advantage. We take a truly global, cross-sector, cross-functional view of risk issues, combining McKinsey’s deep industry insight and strategic skills with a structured risk-management approach, proven methodologies focused on true transformation, analytical tools, and practical implementation.

Your impact within our firm

You’ll work in teams of typically 3–5 consultants, playing an active role in all aspects of client engagement.

You will assist client teams in understanding and quantifying risk exposures, evaluating risk strategies, and building and maintaining risk models by being staffed full-time on one engagement or providing ad-hoc assistance to several engagements.

Over the course of each project, you will gather and analyze information, formulate, and test hypotheses, and develop and communicate recommendations risk-based methodologies to support top management-level strategic decisions. You'll also present results to client management and implement recommendations in collaboration with client team members. In some cases, you will be asked to travel to your client site.

When you join McKinsey, you are joining a firm whose culture is distinctive and inclusive. We will accelerate your development as a leader to create positive, enduring change in the world. You will receive training and coaching on how to better:

  • Structure ambiguous problems and take action to solve them
  • Synthesize clear takeaways from complex information into clear takeaways and recommendations using both qualitative and quantitative methods
  • Work effectively with diverse teams to come up with the best solution and move people and organizations to act
  • Establish trust-based relationships with clients to better serve their organizations
  • Communicate effectively with all audiences, including senior leaders, in a structured manner
  • Develop your leadership style, leveraging your own passions, strengths, and personal values

McKinsey believes in strengths-based development and coaching, and you’ll receive frequent mentoring from colleagues. This will include a senior colleague from your office or practice who will help you grow and achieve your career goals. Additionally, you will have a professional development manager who manages staffing to help you choose projects based on your priorities as well as the needs of client service teams.

Your qualifications and skills

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering or another business-related field; master’s degree is a plus
  • 4+ years of experience in risk management in any industry sector and/or experience in a consultancy (with risk focus) and/or comparable experience in banking, credit risk, collections, fraud, insurance (actuarial experience with life insurance underwriting exposure and/or M&A actuarial background a plus), capital markets, crisis management, cyber risk, trading/intermediation with significant exposure to risk (e.g. commodity trading in the energy sector), or contract/asset structuring
  • Experience managing people
  • Strong natural entrepreneur and comfortable with risk-taking; problem-solving skills and quantitative and analytical thinking capabilities
  • Strong command of Microsoft Excel and VBA
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to adjust and interact with all levels
  • Strong communications skills to facilitate discussions and conduct training
  • Strong project and change management skill
  • Independent self-management skills and ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Capable of executing multiple tasks or projects simultaneously
  • Fluent in English (verbal and written)

Senior HR Analyst, People Analytics

The Senior HR Analyst, People Analytics, will be a member of the Global People Operations and Insights team, which provides data, analytics, operational, and strategic decision support across multiple business units and regions within Mastercard.

This individual will bring experience in analytics, project management, and agile methodologies to enable data-driven decisions about talent at Mastercard. Competitive candidates will be detail-oriented, execution-focused, and adept at identifying opportunities to introduce consistency and scale to analytical outputs within a matrix organization.

Role

  3. Participate in drafting documents and presentations to communicate innovations, ideas, or discoveries.
  4. Contribute to building a motivated, innovative, and productive team that creates next-generation analytics for Mastercard.
  5. Generate and implement ideas to continuously improve analytics and reporting services.
  6. Understand the root query or challenge behind data requests to provide meaningful insights.
  7. Validate and enforce people data integrity in collaboration with Data Management and HR Systems teams.
  8. Manage project responsibilities, seeking guidance from senior team members to handle workload with the Technology team.
  9. Exercise exceptional judgment and discretion when handling sensitive people data.
  10. Bring experience with agile methodologies, preferably Jira.

All About You

  • Experience working with organizational/workforce data.
  • Ability to collaborate across teams and time zones.
  • Flexible, responsive, and adaptable to change.
  • Openness to feedback and strong self-awareness.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Ability to work within data governance and privacy standards.
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for applying data to solve business challenges.
  • Problem-solving skills, resourcefulness, and creativity.
  • Strong interpersonal skills for building relationships and influencing.
  • Proficiency in Alteryx and Tableau/PowerBI.
  • Experience with data preparation/ETL.
  • Knowledge of R or Python.
  • Strong SQL skills for writing, executing, and optimizing queries.
  • Experience developing complex reports and dashboards.
  • Ability to communicate complex analysis clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Desirable

  • Experience with data modeling tools.
  • Experience with optimization models, cloud platforms, Big Data technologies.
  • Knowledge of advanced statistical techniques or machine learning.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Analytics, Computer Science, Business, Psychology, Management, or related field.

Note: Mastercard is a global company; applications from outside listed locations are welcome. Please attach your resume in English.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks carry inherent risks. Employees are responsible for information security, including:

description:
At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.

Cadence Design Systems Inc. is looking for a motivated Lead Software Engineer to work with us in Belo Horizonte, Brazil.

In this role, you will work within Cadence’s Verification IPs (VIP) Foundation Technology team, developing and maintaining software libraries written in C and C++, and developing and maintaining a code generation infrastructure written in Java and Perl. Your role will be of a technical lead in the team, supporting peers in writing high-quality, high-performance, architecturally-sound software.

Cadence VIP provides functional verification for SoC (System on Chip) hardware designs. This is a way to accelerate hardware design and verification. If you want to know more about Cadence VIP, check Cadence Design Systems channel on YouTube.

Cadence has been nominated as a Great Place to Work globally and in Brazil and is also a Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For .

Job Description:

  • Developing and maintaining libraries written in C/C++, which interact with Hardware Description Languages (HDL) such as SystemVerilog. This is essential for ensuring that our software can effectively communicate with each VIP and simulator, which is a fundamental aspect of our product's performance and reliability.
  • Developing and maintaining a code generation infrastructure written in Java and Perl. This infrastructure is crucial for automating the creation of code, which can significantly increase developer productivity, reduce errors, maintain consistency, and accelerate the development cycle.
  • Performing a technical leadership role within the team. This involves guiding the team towards best practices, mentoring junior engineers, and leading by example in terms of code quality and system design.

Requirements:

  • Complete bachelor’s in computer science or computer engineering or equivalent experience.
  • 2 to 5 years of experience in software development.
  • Expertise in any of the following: C, C++, Java, Python.

If you meet some of these qualifications or have some of these skills, we encourage you to apply.

Nice to have:

  • Good communication skills in English.
  • Scripting experience with any of the following: Python, Perl, Bash.
  • Knowledge of Verilog/SystemVerilog.

Additional Job Details:

  • Employment category: CLT.
  • Employment term: 40 hours/week.
  • Hybrid work.
  • Competitive benefits.
  • Location: Av Contorno 5800, Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais Brazil.

The Walt Disney Company, together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading diversified international family entertainment and media enterprise with the following business segments: Disney Entertainment, ESPN, Disney Parks, and Experiences and Products. From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. How you will contribute to our magical experience?

The Walt Disney Company is seeking a temporary professional to support the International Labor Standards (ILS) program during a maternity leave period with fixed contract. This temporary role is based in Brazil and reports to the ILS Manager LTAM, based in Buenos Aires, Argentina.

The Analyst, Labor Standards & Compliance will provide operational and administrative support to ensure alignment with Disney’s commitment to responsible ILS Program across Disney's Licensees & Suppliers.

The Analyst, Labor Standards & Compliance (Temp Role – 7 months) will be responsible for:

  • Supporting the ongoing engagement and training of internal business units, licensees, suppliers, and other stakeholders.
  • Responding to inquiries related to ILS audits, policies, and requirements.
  • Supporting our Licensees & Suppliers to maintain accurate data in the system (including licensee, factory, audit, and relationship records).
  • Ensure alignment of business practices and operations with ILS global objectives.
  • Assist the ILS Manager in executing the ILS Program by liaising with business units, licensees, and suppliers—supporting audit processes, addressing factory-related issues, and leading remediation initiatives.
  • Design and deliver compliance awareness trainings and capacity-building initiatives for internal ILS teams and manufacturing facilities. Monitor project progress, maintain communication with internal and external stakeholders, and support evaluation and continuous improvement.
  • Provide support to the ILS Manager on special projects aligned with compliance objectives. Responsibilities may include preparing ad hoc presentations, translating materials, drafting reports and status updates, and contributing to program strategy, planning, performance tracking, and trend analysis.

What we need from you to be part of this story:

  • 2-3+ years of experience as a Social Compliance Auditors or CSR/Sustainability/Ethical Sourcing/Social Compliance Programs in other sectors (retailers, textile, toys, etc).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications, Sustainability, Law, Occupational Safety Engineering, or a related field.
  • Advanced level of English. Intermediate level of Spanish (is a plus).
  • Preferred Industries: Audit Firms, CSR/Sustainability/Ethical Sourcing from retailers, textile, toys or other related companies.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.
  • Very detailed-oriented and organized.
  • Flexible to travel and able to work in a multi-task environment.
  • Analytical and reporting skills with experience using pivot tables to manage/analyze large datasets (preferred).
  • Team player, responsible, hardworking, and adaptable, able to adjust quickly.

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. title: Java Developer - PCD - Brasil
description:
VAGA EXCLUSIVA PARA BANCO DE TALENTOS EM TECNOLOGIA DE PESSOAS COM DEFICIÊNCIA

Na Globant acreditamos que uma cultura inclusiva e um ambiente diversificado nos tornam mais fortes. Encorajamos as pessoas a terem um espírito inclusivo à medida que a nossa presença global se expande, sempre buscando gerar um lugar de inspiração e crescimento para todos, independentemente de raça, cor, religião, origem nacional, orientação sexual, idade, estado civil, deficiência ou identidade de gênero. Um espaço seguro, baseado na equidade como valor, onde a carreira de todos pode ser promovida e desenvolvida da mesma forma. Não há inovação sem diversidade e não há melhoria sem pluralidade.

Somos uma empresa de serviços de tecnologia digitalmente nativa onde inovação, design e engenharia se encontram em escala. Utilizamos algumas das mais recentes tecnologias no campo digital e cognitivo para capacitar as organizações em todos os aspectos.

Você terá a chance de:

  • Trabalhar com profissionais que criaram algumas das soluções mais revolucionárias em seus campos.
  • Fazer um impacto. Trabalhar em projetos de grande escala globalmente.
  • Desenvolver sua carreira em nossos Studios. Cada Studio representa bolsões de especialização nas últimas tecnologias e tendências e oferece soluções personalizadas focadas em desafios específicos.
  • Desenvolver sua carreira dentro de uma indústria ou múltiplas indústrias.
  • Trabalhar na cidade que você deseja e ser alimentado por trocas culturais.
  • Ser capacitado para escolher seu caminho de carreira: temos mais de 600 projetos simultâneos, então você pode escolher onde e como trabalhar.
  • Fazer parte de um pod ágil. Impulsionado por uma cultura de trabalho em equipe auto-regulada, cada equipe - ou POD - trabalha diretamente com nossos clientes com um caminho de maturidade completo que evolui à medida que aumentam a velocidade, qualidade e autonomia.

O que ajudará você a ter sucesso:

  • Habilidades avançadas em inglês.
  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento de software prático trabalhando com as últimas versões do Java como a principal linguagem de programação e familiaridade com o uso de funcionalidades como Lambdas e Java Streams.
  • Análise e design orientados a objetos usando padrões de design comuns.
  • Conhecimento de Bancos de Dados Relacionais, SQL e tecnologias ORM (por exemplo, JPA2, Hibernate, MyBatis).
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicativos usando frameworks Spring.
  • Compreensão de ferramentas de versionamento de código, como Git.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de compilação como Maven ou Gradle.
  • Familiaridade com processos de desenvolvimento de integração contínua e entrega contínua usando ferramentas como Jenkins, Bamboo, GitLab, etc.
  • Familiaridade com tecnologias e plataformas de nuvem.
  • Experiência em escrever testes unitários usando JUnit, Mockito.
  • Experiência na construção de APIs REST.
  • Experiência com outras coisas não listadas acima seria valiosa, como: Modelagem de dados, Docker, Kubernetes, JSF, Mensagens (Kafka, RabbitMQ, PubSub. etc), NoSQL, Metodologia Ágil e Código Limpo.

“Se eu me inscrever, eu vou automaticamente participar de um processo de recrutamento?”
Todas as pessoas inscritas nesta oportunidade terão seus perfis analisados cuidadosamente e serão convidadas para um processo seletivo caso existam posições abertas nas suas áreas de interesse, com base nas suas experiências e aspirações de carreira.

Caso você seja selecionado para nosso processo, haverá um profissional específico para entrar em contato com você e te passar todas as informações necessárias a respeito das próximas etapas do processo seletivo.

Conheça nossa cultura

O Agibank é para quem vive em eterna busca de conhecimento e não para mesmo quando tudo e todos jogam contra.

Quem faz parte, sabe que, ao superar desafios, coisas boas acontecem para o cliente, para a empresa e para sua própria carreira. Aqui, a gente se orgulha de reunir uma galera assim: agilizada, gente aberta, corajosa e que busca crescimento.

Prepare-se para sair totalmente da zona de conforto , para escutar feedbacks empáticos, mas radicalmente francos, e para transformar todos os desafios em oportunidade de aprendizado.

No Agibank, a vontade de crescer corre na veia, e quando essa vontade se junta, ela não pede licença. E o ambiente abre passagem para quem transforma caminho em estrada.

Juntos, lutamos por uma experiência bancária que acolhe e encoraja todos os brasileiros.

Se você sentiu seu coração bater forte daí, o Agibank pode ser pra você. Vamos crescer juntos?

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

Seu papel será entender profundamente as necessidades do(a) cliente e conectá-las às nossas soluções financeiras com muita empatia, conhecimento sobre o mercado e encantamento. Conheça um pouco mais do(a) Agente Stone no nosso manifesto .

title: Category Manager
description:
Company Overview

If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

Team Overview

Are you a Category Manager? Are you a BP? Here we do it all... If you are creative, energetic, hands-on, and a strong-minded team player, come join our amazing Procurement team in Brazil!

Here you will elaborate and execute strategic and operational Procurement activities across the Global Procurement Organization. Ensure alignment to business necessities and stakeholders, as well as the Procurement guidelines and goals. Position will report to the Regional Director of Procurement with a close connection to our global organization.

Role Responsibilities

  1. Lead and execute the end-to-end sourcing process and facilitate analysis and collaboration of cross-functional teams. Partner with regional and global organization colleagues implementing effective sourcing processes.
  2. Experience working with different Procurement categories (Indirect).
  3. Develop and lead negotiation strategy to maximize total value and minimize risk.
  4. Execute total cost of ownership analysis, execute supply-market research/benchmark and conduct pricing audits aiming for continuous cost and process improvement.
  5. Ensure that the business requirements and drivers are well understood and SLA’s/KPI’s will be achieved accordingly.
  6. Ensure compliance and adherence to the Procurement guidelines.
  7. Identify opportunities to maximize general corporate results and contribute to the development of the Professional Services category strategies (among others).
  8. Drive the change management of Professional Services Procurement transformation process. Act as a business partner and represent Procurement within the global procurement organization.
  9. Challenge legacy processes and ways of working being creative, dynamic and developing strategies to speed up business growth.
  10. Lead all relevant business partner and supplier interactions including senior levels throughout all steps within the Procurement end-to-end process.

Role Qualifications

  1. Proven experience in complex matrix organizations and fast-paced environment companies. Experience in global/regional roles is a plus.
  2. Experience with strategic sourcing and procurement methodologies, contracts, and supplier management.
  3. Strong in risk and compliance management.
  4. Excellent analytical, presentation, and communication skills. Strong sense of urgency.
  5. Ability to engage and influence others, deep understanding of what is the role of a Procurement BP.
  6. Creative, energetic, hands-on, and strong-minded team player with a high level of self-management.
  7. English fluency is mandatory. Spanish is a plus.

EEO Statement

  • We create customer value – We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant, and efficient.
  • We are data-driven – We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.
  • We believe in Win-win Collaboration – Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.
  • We believe in integrity – Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.
  • We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.
  • We believe in Diversity and Inclusion – Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what makes us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.
Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a future vision or a wish for something we want someday; it is a non-negotiable value of who we are today.

We embrace inclusion, plurality, and respect, and to achieve this, we rely on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works alongside HR, our leadership, and identity groups—99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Colors, 99Women, and 99Families.

This is our ongoing journey, with much more still to come.

We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).

description:

Valores que buscamos:

  • Pensamento orientado com foco no cliente #OClienteéaRazão
  • Mindset ágil, que se adapta rápido à mudança #Leveza
  • Foco em soluções e resolução de problemas #SuaVozTemValor
  • Autonomia, iniciativa e protagonismo são essenciais #DeixaComigo
  • Paixão, brilho nos olhos e autenticidade #SejaVocê!
  • Querer fazer parte de uma empresa ética que entrega valor à sociedade #ValeaPena
  • Pessoas inconformadas que pensam lá na frente em busca da evolução #SomosIpiranga
  • Mentalidade de dono e sede resultados crescentes #FaçoAcontecer

Quais serão suas responsabilidades e desafios?

Buscamos um Especialista em CRM que tenha como principal característica a determinação.

O profissional atuará junto aos times de TI e Negócios, será responsável por conduzir e monitorar a jornada estratégica do CRM, controlando à evolução da ORG a partir de integrações de diversas áreas do negócio (áreas e componentes). Atuará em conjunto com as consultorias de desenvolvimento, squads de desenvolvimento e o fornecedor do CRM.

A posição requer sólido conhecimento em CRM (preferencialmente Salesforce) e entendimento da jornada comercial. Requer ainda excelentes habilidades relacionais, experiência técnica para elaborar apresentações de status Reports e similares. O conhecimento sobre mercado de commodities e distribuição de combustíveis será um diferencial para a posição.

  • Definir a estratégia CRM da Ipiranga tornando-o uma referência dentro do segmento e do próprio conceito de CRM.
  • Manter alinhamento constante com as partes para assegurar a integração eficaz dos diversos componentes que geram a evolução do CRM.
  • Atuar como o principal ponto de contato entre a equipe técnica e as áreas de negócios, compreendendo suas necessidades e traduzindo essas necessidades em soluções tecnológicas.
  • Realizar análises regulares de tendências e benchmarks para garantir que o CRM esteja atualizado com as melhores práticas do mercado.
  • Escrita de business cases, levantamento de requisitos, elaboração de documentação funcional, elaboração e execução de cenários de testes e homologação de entregas junto a fornecedores.
  • Em conjunto com a consultoria externa, implementar evoluções e ajustes no sistema, garantindo a integração contínua com as operações e processos da empresa.
  • Realizar reuniões e pesquisas regulares com stakeholders para coletar feedback, entender problemas e propor entregas no Roadmap do CRM.
  • Conduzir treinamentos e sessões de capacitação para os usuários do sistema, garantindo que a equipe esteja atualizada e faça uso correto das funcionalidades do CRM.
  • Criar e apresentar relatórios de status com atualizações sobre o projeto CRM.

O que você precisa ter para conquistar essa posição?

  • Graduação completa
  • Inglês intermediário
  • Capacidade de estruturar materiais e fazer apresentações
  • Conhecimento avançado em Pacote Office
  • Experiência comprovada em análise de negócios (BA)
  • Experiência aprofundada com plataforma CRM (preferencialmente Salesforce) e suas tecnologias
  • Habilidade em apresentar insights e soluções para aprimorar a jornada e percepção de valor do CRM
  • Capacidade analítica e de interpretação de processos

title: Senior or Staff Software Engineer, Data Product
description:
TRM is on a mission to build a safer financial system for billions of people. We deliver a blockchain intelligence data platform to financial institutions, crypto companies, and governments to fight cryptocurrency fraud and financial crime. We consider our business — and our profit — as a way to move towards our mission sustainably and at scale.

The Data Product team collaborates with an experienced group of data scientists, engineers, and product managers to build highly scalable features that power TRM's products and services. As a Software Engineer on the Data Product team, you will be responsible for designing and building mission-critical data services. These features analyze and provide insights into blockchain transaction activity at petabyte scale, and ultimately work to build a safer financial system for billions of people.

The impact you’ll have here:

  • Build highly scalable features that integrate with dozens of blockchains.
  • Design and architect intricate data models for optimal storage and retrieval to support sub-second latency for querying blockchain data.
  • Collaborate across departments, partnering with data scientists, backend engineers, and product managers to design and implement novel data models that enhance TRM’s products.

What we’re looking for:

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science or a related field.
  • A proven track record, with 5+ years of hands-on experience in architecting scalable API development, distributed system architecture, guiding projects from initial ideation through to successful production deployment.
  • Exceptional programming skills in Python, as well as adeptness in SQL or SparkSQL.
  • Versatility that spans the entire spectrum of data engineering in one or more of the following areas:
    • In-depth experience with data stores such as BigQuery and Postgres.
    • Proficiency in data pipeline and workflow orchestration tools like Airflow and DBT.
    • Expertise in data processing technologies and streaming workflows including Dataflow, Spark, Kafka, and Flink.
    • Competence in deploying and monitoring infrastructure within public cloud platforms, utilizing tools such as Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Datadog.
    • Proven ability in loading, querying, and transforming extensive datasets.

About the Team:

  • Our team is spread out over several countries and time zones. To leverage the opportunities and address challenges that come with this working model, we've built a culture grounded in trust, transparency, and adaptability. Even though we're scattered across different time zones, we stay closely connected through open communication and regular check-ins.
  • The diversity of perspectives and expertise within our team sparks creative exchanges and enhances our problem-solving capabilities, allowing us to leverage our global synergy to drive innovation and efficiency.
  • We're driven by a deep sense of ownership, constant pursuit of improvement and an obsession with delivering magical experiences to our customers; these are a core part of our culture.
  • We're driven by the desire to continuously hone our craft and to this end, we regularly assess our processes, seek feedback, and embrace iterative development to refine what we do.
  • We structure problems and use the 80/20 rule to identify where to direct our razor-sharp focus.
  • Each of us is passionate about excellence and growth, and we're encouraged to challenge the status quo and experiment with new methods.
  • By celebrating our successes and learning from our setbacks, we stay agile and forward-thinking, always striving to elevate our performance and impact.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • The team received a request from customers to show the running balance for assets tied to an address within the product. They brainstormed to determine the minimal viable solution that could be delivered within two weeks.
  • The team was tasked with implementing a new feature that would enable TRM to gather feedback from the user community swiftly.
  • The team was tasked with developing a solution to reveal Indirect Exposure through cross-chain swaps in response to a competitor's similar feature.

About TRM's Engineering Levels:

Engineer: Responsible for helping to define project milestones and executing small decision decisions independently with the appropriate tradeoffs between simplicity, readability, and performance.

Senior Engineer: Successfully designs and documents system improvements and features for an OKR/project from the ground up.

Staff Engineer: Drives scoping and execution of one or more OKRs/projects that impact multiple teams.

Life at TRM Labs

Leadership Principles

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first, driving for speed, focus, and adaptability.
  • Master Craftsperson: We prioritize speed, high standards, and distributed ownership.
  • Inspiring Colleague: We value humility, candor, and a one-team mindset.

Build a Career

Joining TRM means being part of a mission-driven team comprised of industry leaders. At TRM, you'll experience:

  • Purpose and Mission: Have a real-world impact, from disrupting terrorist networks to returning stolen funds.
  • Inspiring Colleagues: Collaborate with industry leaders and learn something new daily.
  • Personal Growth: We're not just using technology; we're inventing it and taking category-defining products to market.

Work Environment

  • Remote First: Our HQ is online. Tools like Zoom and Slack ensure seamless collaboration.
  • Ownership & TRM Speed: Small teams drive big goals at TRM.
  • Diversity and Inclusion: Diversity at TRM encompasses backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.
  • Annual Company Offsite: Once a year, TRMers come together from around the world to attend a 1-week mandatory company offsite.

Join Us

We're looking for team members who love building from the ground up and want to work hard in a fast-paced and ambitious environment.

We encourage you to reach out even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra,determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

  • Foco no cliente:Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande:Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta:Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor:Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

>> Sobre a vaga

Product Manager de Previdência na Business Unit Seguridade.

A BU tem a missão de proporcionar aos clientes soluções financeiras de longo prazo, garantindo segurança e bem estar no futuro por meio de produtos de seguros e previdência que combinem rentabilidade e proteção.

A squad de Previdência busca simplificar um produto complexo, por meio de uma experiência eficiente e segura para clientes via autosserviço ou assessoria de planejamento financeiro. Além de garantir a conformidade regulatória da Susep, tem a missão de potencializar a captação de recursos e atuar na retenção de clientes, ao viabilizar soluções exclusivas que facilitem a jornada e aumentem a atratividade do produto para clientes e força de vendas.

Principais responsabilidades:

Definir a visão e a estratégia do produto, alinhando com as necessidades do mercado e dos clientes.

As atividades consistem em desdobrar o planejamento e execução da estratégia e dos objetivos da Business Unit, criando soluções, priorizando roadmap e colaborando com os demais times, utilizando o VSTS como ferramenta de gestão de produtos.

Especificação de regras de negócio e escrita de estórias.

Conduzir pesquisas de mercado e análise de concorrência para identificar oportunidades de desenvolvimento de produtos.

Trabalhar em colaboração com equipes multifuncionais, incluindo engenharia, design, marketing e vendas, para garantir a entrega de produtos de alta qualidade e zelo pela satisfação e boa experiência na jornada de previdência do cliente ou assessor.

Gerenciar o ciclo de vida do produto, desde a concepção até o lançamento e iteração contínua.

Monitorar métricas de desempenho do produto por meio de analise e interpretação de dados e realizar ajustes conforme necessário para maximizar resultados.

Garantir que todos os produtos estejam em conformidade com regulamentações e políticas internas.

Gerenciar stakeholders, mantendo todas as pessoas atualizadas sobre o andamento, resultados e KPIs do produto, dando clareza dos próximos passos e alinhando expectativas entre todos, sendo responsável pela entrega do seu produto.

Estruturar cases para utilização de Open Insurance.

>> Para esta vaga, é essencial:

Experiência prévia como Product Manager ou em áreas de Produtos, preferencialmente em previdência.

Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis e ferramentas de gestão de produtos.

Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração.

Proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico.

Problem solving & Skills analíticos (Capacidade Analítica), realizando análises que o são demandadas e/ou necessárias para solucionar um problema dentro da sua área de atuação.

Liderança e influência para engajar pessoas para que o valor seja entregue e resultados sejam atingidos.

>>Vocêpodeterdestaquese:

Experiência em Mercado Financeiro ou Seguros;

Conhecimento prévio de Open Insurance;

Experiência em Produtos Digitais;

Experiência com gestão de projetos (PMO);

Conhecimento em fundamentos da agilidade.

>> Modelo de trabalho:

Atuamos no formato hibrido, idas ao escritório 3x por semana.

“Se te oferecem um lugar em um foguete, não pergunte qual é o assento, apenas embarque.”

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass , Zenklub , VA, VR, New Value , seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia .

title: Técnico em Meio Ambiente - Região Metropolitana do Rio de Janeiro/RJ
description:
CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

Por meio deste edital, a AVSI Brasil lança a seleção de um profissional para função de Técnico em Meio Ambiente. O profissional será inserido em projeto de eficiência energética, cuja lógica é a de troca de resíduos recicláveis por bônus na fatura de energia elétrica. Tal iniciativa considera a educação ambiental, por meio da reciclagem, como elemento fundamentador da construção de uma sociedade com maior responsabilidade social e ambiental.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O profissional terá como responsabilidade principal a elaboração de Estudos de Viabilidade Técnica - EVT, emissão e controle de Manifesto de Transporte de Resíduos - MTR, processamento de dados e emissão de relatórios. Além disso, fornecerá suporte abrangente às atividades do projeto, auxiliando o Supervisor de Operação nas rotinas de monitoramento dos pontos de coleta fixos e itinerantes, e deverá apoiar o Coordenador do projeto no acompanhamento das atividades e metas gerais.

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO:

  1. Produzir Estudo de Viabilidade Técnica (EVT) relacionado ao gerenciamento de resíduos recicláveis;
  2. Identificar e contatar potenciais clientes, especialmente grandes geradores de resíduos, em busca de novas parcerias;
  3. Produzir Estudo de Viabilidade Técnica - EVT, para avaliação de novos parceiros e abertura de ecopontos, bem como emitir e controlar os MTR - Manifesto de Transporte de Resíduos, produzidos pelos ecopontos;
  4. Manter contato e relacionamento proativo com os clientes do projeto;
  5. Aumentar o nível qualitativo das coletas dos grandes geradores por meio da execução de assistências técnicas, treinamentos e palestras sobre melhores práticas de gerenciamento de resíduos;
  6. Identificar e promover o tratamento de eventuais não conformidades;
  7. Alimentar os indicadores do projeto e emitir relatórios periódicos de desempenho;
  8. Auxiliar e prestar suporte operacional sempre que necessário ao Supervisor de Operações.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Solvd Inc. is a premier software engineering company. We have 8 offices across the globe and over 800 international employees on staff. With over 12 years of experience, highly skilled teams around the world and deep industry knowledge, we help clients create software that improves their operations and opens new markets. We have built an impressive roster of digital-native enterprise clients including some of the biggest brands in retail and social media.

We are looking for a business-minded Data Analyst to join our growing team.

This opportunity will focus on delivering key reporting, analysis, and insights that will help to drive organic traffic growth.


Responsibilities:
  • You will collaborate with product and organic growth teams in order to define tests, analyze trends, and communicate insights.
  • Be part of a highly visible team to tackle strategic initiatives for Organic Growth.
  • Lead discussions with product managers (organic growth manager) to understand requirements.
  • Deliver business insights and explain day-to-day performance trends with a deep understanding of business drivers and macro trends.
  • Conduct hands-on, deep dive analyses using a variety of tools– SQL/Looker, slides, Mode, spreadsheets, etc.
  • Develop and maintain deep dive tools that will quickly identify and predict performance patterns.
Requirements:
  • 3+ years of experience in data analytics or a related field.
  • 1+ year of hands-on experience in A/B testing measurement and readouts.
  • Strong SQL skills (fluent understanding, ability to write complex queries).
  • Proficiency in Python for scripting and data manipulation.
  • Experience with business intelligence and visualization tools (Looker, MODAP, Grafana, ELK – a plus).
  • Familiarity with cloud-based analytics (AWS Athena, Clickhouse, Metabase – preferred).
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex analyses to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in Google Suite (G-Suite) .
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a quantitative field (Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Business, or related).
